desc:
Welcome to Build Your Friends! 🧱

🙌 Build anyone on Roblox out of blocks! You, your best friend, or a YouTuber you love!

🧍 Pick a player. Their avatar shows up on your plot.
🧱 Grab blocks. Stack them up high on your head!
⬇️ Walk over the right spots and the blocks drop in.
🗿 Finish it and it turns into a BIG statue!

💸 Your statues make money for you. They make money when you are not playing too!
⬆️ Buy upgrades. Carry more blocks, run faster and get more money!
🌈 Upgrade your statues!!

👥 Build with your friends!
💾 Your game saves by itself!

Who will YOU build first? 👀
